document.title: Auto-send links in DM

source.description_exact: Automate DMs to send followers to your website. Sick of saying “link in bio” like a broken record? Just slide your website link right into their DMs
source.preview_text_exact:
Instagram
Auto-send links in DM
Business value
You’ll get more site visits, more sales, and higher conversions, all because you cut the bio scavenger hunt. Bonus: You also grow your contact list for retargeting.
How does it work?
Someone comments or DMs about a product and Manychat instantly sends your link. Works for stores, blogs, or affiliate sites.

rendered_totals_exact.matching: Trigger left -> start center -> followup right. Button edge and 60-second within-message block observed. Next Step ports unconnected.

graph_integrity.limitation: Original graph is not exposed. Draft edges use visible navigation identity; no hidden IDs or server export.

json_exact.before: 3 alternative keywords in one contains condition
json_exact.inspection_value: Added a second empty AND condition; opened AI conversion form

selection.choose_when: Use an inbound keyword DM with an explicit button before link delivery and a 60-second follow-up.
selection.avoid_when: Do not use when exact button callbacks and timing must survive Chatfuel migration.

safety.delivery_limit: No Set Live or send action. Scoped 0 runs before trigger removal and n/a list metrics are not account-wide no-delivery proof.

gaps: Original server settings and IDs were not exported. Clone defaults are not asserted to equal source defaults.
Runtime was not tested because execution is forbidden; this is separate from settings completeness.
All existing node defaults were opened. Shared options are evidence-matched; exhaustive alternative node-type conversion is not proven.
